message: 紫央ちゃんと一緒

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you go up the front approach of Asukai Shrine and lie in wait beneath the torii gate. I'll circle around to the back approach.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really mind, but?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio will definitely run that way, so grab hold of her for me. Leave the rest to me afterward.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」
For a little while now, I've been tilting my head to the side in puzzlement.
Today, with less than a month left until Christmas, I was summoned by Misa.
Prefacing that she had an important matter to discuss, Misa didn't bring up Student Council or Holy Night Festival business, nor fears about the Crusaders, demons, or Re-Crea.
Apparently, Misa's sworn little sister, Shio-chan, has some terrible worry on her mind.
However, why do we need to catch Shio-chan? In the first place, Misa won't explain what she's even worried about.
...It's a matter between sisters, after all. There's probably heartache that's hard to tell others about. I shouldn't pry too deeply.

name: Synn
message: 「Spacing ouuuut~~~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing to do. Just how long am I supposed to stay here...」

name: Shio
message: 「G-Guooohhh?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't let out a scream like you're dying!!」

name: Shio
message: 「However, lying in ambush inside the restroom is going too far, indeed.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up, if I don't go this far, I'll never catch you, Shio.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmph, as expected of Big Sister, you know this humble one quite well.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! Don't lock me in!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Take your time.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Could it be that I got dragged into a sibling quarrel?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're just realizing that now? There's no 'could it be' about it--that's exactly what this is.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh?! W-Why is Synn-dono standing there!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're super energetic, huh, Shio-chan? You don't look like you have any anxieties at all.」

name: Shio
message: 「Even if I have no anxieties, I certainly have grievances. Synn-dono, would you kindly step aside?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, don't you dare move!」

name: Shio
message: 「S-She's already caught up?! Big Sister is dead serious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait right there, Shio!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh... What's the right move for me to make here?」

name: Shio
message: 「What is this?! The back approach to the shrine is locked shut!」

name: Misa
message: 「I won't let you get away! Give it up!」

name: Misa
message: 「What was up with your test results the other day?! It's faster to count from the bottom! You promised you'd place in the top 10, Shio!!」
S-So she made a declaration like that.

name: Shio
message: 「I-I have no recollection of such a thing!」

name: Misa
message: 「No, you definitely said it!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Pray tell, what year, month, day, hour, minute, and second did I say this?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm going to get mad, you know?! I will not accept such pathetic excuses!」

name: Shio
message: 「Big Sister's hair is already standing on end with rage!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's because you keep making nothing but excuses, Shio!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Less like a sister spat and more like a mother-daughter quarrel.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's weird. Shio-chan isn't running this way.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, if Synn-sama spots her, her escape route's completely cut off.」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono. If you have finished your prayers, kindly take your leave at once.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah, I didn't come here to worship today.」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I knew it...! Someone of your stature as Student Council President intends to be Big Sister's accomplice?!」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude! Don't phrase it like we're doing something shady! I just want to make Shio study!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sounds like a great big sister to me.」

name: Shio
message: 「B-Big Sister, one does not live by studies and test scores alone. What truly matters is the state of one's heart!」

name: Shio
message: 「From this day forward, I wish to compete on inner character!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's a completely valid argument, yet it somehow sounds like total sophistry?」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, it's just as Shio says.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, you agree with me? We truly are sisters!」

name: Misa
message: 「However, wouldn't it be fine to compete in both substance and test scores?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. No matter how you look at it, doing both is fine.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nugugugu...」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my? There's a rainbow in the sky--」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't try to change the subject!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, Misa, nobody in this world is perfect.」

name: Shio
message: 「Did you hear that? Even Synn-dono says so! That means it doesn't matter if I have five or six weak subjects.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's way too many! Make an effort to overcome them!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, instead of that, why not polish your strong subjects into an unbeatable weapon? You can offset your weak subjects with your total score and aim for the top ranks.」

name: Misa
message: 「That makes sense... Shio, what is your best subject?」

name: Shio
message: 「Physical education!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Hmph.」

name: Shio
message: 「I-It was just a jest!」

name: Shio
message: 「My best subject... best... something I can score well in...」

name: Shio
message: 「Ummmm...」

name: Shio
message: 「Ngh!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuhu. Kuhu, kuhuhuhuhuhu...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wait, Shio-chan! Why are you drawing your sword!?」

name: Shio
message: 「It doesn't matter anymore, nothing does...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What doesn't?」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono... won't you pass on to the next world together with me...?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Where to?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Run, Sakura-kun! Some weird switch just flipped inside Shio!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one who flipped it, Misa!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my? Look, noctilucent clouds in the sky--」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaah?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Where are you going, Synn-dono...? I hate being all alone... I shall follow you, no matter how far...」

name: Synn
message: 「Kyaaaah, stoooop! Stay away from meeee!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Calm down, Shio! I won't tell you to place in the top 10 anymore, top 12 next time is fine!」
Shio-chan chased me around, while Misa chased after Shio-chan.
...This game of tag continued until Riesling-san popped up out of nowhere and confiscated Shio-chan's naginata.
Since I'm already here, I might as well pray for the success of the Holy Night Festival at Asukai Shrine.
